free_tier.stated: No storage quota. Kakao's message API takes an IMAGE URL that you host yourself; it does not accept a binary upload and store it for you.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: N/A. There is no Kakao-hosted media to egress. The direction is the opposite of what this project needs: Kakao asks YOU for a public URL.

tooling: kakao-business SDKs / raw REST; channel management APIs. Nothing that stores blobs.
chaining: Not chainable. It is a message-delivery API, not an object store. Being a URL consumer rather than a URL producer makes it structurally useless here.
limits_note: Image is passed as a URL reference with Kakao's own size/format constraints on the linked asset; no upload endpoint, no media_id, no retention to speak of.
